The introduction states the aim is to understand CLN1 disease pathology by studying Ppt1-deficient mice. The consistent reference to these animals as models of CLN1 disease, combined with the statement that findings reveal 'CLN1 pathogenesis,' clearly establishes that Ppt1 deficiency causes CLN1 disease.

The abstract is structured as a study of CLN1 disease pathology using Ppt1-/- mice as the disease model. The results section explicitly lists microglial activation as part of the CLN1 disease pathology timeline. This is a phenotypic finding of the disease.

The 'This' refers to microglial activation in Ppt1-/- spinal cords, establishing that these findings are part of the CLN1 disease pathology timeline described in the study.
